name: Merissa Stilwell
summary: Merissa Stilwell is a young human townsperson residing at Northshire Abbey within Elwynn Forest. Standing near the abbey, she offers a cheerful greeting and a helping hand to the newcomers training in Northshire Valley.

sections.title: A Welcoming Face in Northshire
sections.body: Standing at Northshire Abbey, Merissa Stilwell greets the fresh recruits who arrive in Northshire Valley. For wandering novices, she offers simple hospitality and practical advice on resting up and getting oriented. Sharing a surname with notable craftsmen and homesteaders across the kingdom—such as the blacksmith Jordan Stilwell and the Westfall defender Daphne Stilwell—she remains a peaceful local face amidst the kingdom's rising tensions.

faq.answer: Merissa is a friendly human resident of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest, offering advice and a warm welcome to the travelers who arrive there.

faq.q: Where can I find Merissa Stilwell?
faq.answer: She is located at Northshire Abbey in Northshire Valley, in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Is Merissa related to the other Stilwells in the kingdom?
faq.answer: While she shares her surname with prominent figures like the smith Jordan Stilwell and Daphne Stilwell in Westfall, she lives quietly at Northshire Abbey, welcoming travelers rather than fighting bandits or forging blades.

faq.q: Does Merissa Stilwell offer any quests?
faq.answer: No. She has no task of her own for travelers; she simply greets the newcomers who pass through Northshire.

angles.text: For Alliance recruits leaving the sheltered cloister of Northshire, Merissa represents the warm hospitality of Elwynn before the harsh realities of the Defias threat set in.
